about_the_game:
Courier Simulator puts you behind the wheel of a realistic delivery experience where logistics meets life simulation. Start your shift at the warehouse, load up your packages, and hit the road as a professional courier. Whether you're navigating tight city streets or planning your delivery route for maximum efficiency, every decision shapes your day.

Core Gameplay

  • Start Your Shift – Log into your driver account, check available jobs, and prepare your van for a day of deliveries.

  • Load & Deliver – Choose packages based on location, value, or time constraints. Plan your route and deliver with precision.

  • Warehouse Workflow – Return to the hub to end your shift, drop off the van, and transition back into your personal life.

  • Build Your Life – Spend your earnings on new cars or invest in property. Buy, upgrade, and sell to climb the social and financial ladder.

Key Features

  • Realistic courier job simulation with a focus on routine, responsibility, and freedom.

  • Open delivery system — choose what, when, and where to deliver.

  • A living world with economic opportunities outside your shift — from property management to car collection.

  • A mix of job realism and lifestyle freedom, allowing you to create your own path.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bit) or Newer (64 bit) Windows OS
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7500 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti / AMD RX 560 (4GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bit) or Newer (64 bit) Windows OS
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-11400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 Super / AMD RX 580 or better (6GB+ VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: Connect to your driver account on the warehouse desktop , get on shift and load the packages in the van. Deliver the packages , choosing the packages to deliver based on your own preferences. After the shift ends , leave the van at the warehouse and get your personal car and drive to your home.
